notes:
High-level: Pixelora is a global contact-center SaaS focused on mid/enterprise telco and fintech customers. They want to add an LLM-powered layer for agent assist, live translation, automated ticket summarization, and tool-calling (CRM updates, ticket triage) while preserving strict regional residency. Key ask: must handle multilingual (EN/ES/FR/BR-PT) with locale-aware tone. Currently evaluating Redwood vs internal infra + Genesys integrations.

Sales notes (shorthand):
- 11/20 initial inbound (SE exec ref) - strong product interest around latency during spike windows.
- 12/10 demo: showed guided agent assist + tool-call prototype; CS manager: "need 99p under stress or fallback plan."
- 01/05 security kickoff: asked for SOC2 + ISO docs, KMS integration and audit log schema.
- 02/18 POC ingest start: 2w of anonymized tickets from NA + EU + LATAM (200k messages).
- 03/01 stress test: 3x traffic spike reproduction; Redwood requested to tune batching and KV cache params.

Customer constraints: VPC deployment for production, EU data residency for several customers, contractual SLA 99.95% with multi-region failover. Prefer ability to pin model versions and fallback to smaller quantized variants during overload.

Quote from Head of CS: "We can’t have tone mismatches — local phrasing matters; Spanish in LATAM must not feel translated from Castilian."

POC success metrics: summary accuracy >= 88% (human eval), agent assist latency p50 < 120ms, p95 < 700ms under 1.5x baseline load; graceful degradation during 3x spikes (fallback model response w/in 2s), cost per 1k tokens under target for EU traffic.

requirements_summary: Multi-locale agent assist: must support real-time suggestions (tool calls) integrated with their ticketing API; ticket summarization for handoff + SLA tagging; live on-the-fly translation with locale-aware tone models; routing by customer region and language; deterministic fallback models for overload. Latency targets: agent assist p50 < 120ms, p95 < 700ms at baseline; sustain 3x traffic spikes with graceful degradation. Security: VPC/private deployment for prod, KMS/HSM key control, SSO/SAML, audit logs, data residency + retention controls. Preference for model catalog with pinned versions + A/B rollout capability.
decision_criteria: 1) Meet EU data residency + contractual DPA terms; 2) Proven latency & reliability at scale (benchmarks); 3) Clear cost predictability (dedicated vs hosted); 4) Ops visibility (per-route token costs, tracing) 5) Easy SAML + KMS integration
